title: 5 Americans and Ecuadorean Official Are Killed in Helicopter Crash in Kenya
summary_full: Ecuador’s director of national intelligence was also among those who died in the crash. The search and recovery efforts were being hampered by a fire at the site and the difficult terrain, officials said.
